title: SearchGPT streaming gets its own cache entries
summary:
Two fixes made SearchGPT streaming cache correctly and image flags less willing to believe typos.

The text API cache now accounts for the `stream` parameter, so a streaming SearchGPT request won't receive a cached non-streaming response.

Image parameter sanitization now treats malformed values as false for `enhance`, `nologo`, `nofeed`, and `private`. Feed events also receive a boolean `enhance` value.
